jobs.description:
If you enjoy working on real robots in real environments and want to see your software operating in 
the field, this role offers the opportunity to make a tangible impact in a fast-growing and innovative 
sector.
 

This is what your job will look like:
 

As a robotic engineer, you will be part of our driven engineering team, where you will work together to 
develop high-quality software solutions. Your tasks will include:
 
 

• Develop, maintain, and improve robotic software using 
ROS2 

• Integrate and optimize 
navigation stacks, SLAM, and sensor fusion 

• Build perception systems using 
Computer Vision (e.g., object detection, visual localization) 

• Design and deploy 
Machine Learning models for robotic perception and autonomous decisionmaking 

• Work hands-on with real robots: system integration, deployment, tuning, and performance 
optimization 

• Contribute to robot control, localization, and path planning 

• Participate in on-site testing and customer deployments across Belgium and the Netherlands  

That's why this job suits you:
 
 

• You are hands-on and have 3-5 years of experience and strong affinity with autonomous navigation, robotics, machine control or industrial automation 

• Thorough knowledge of 
ROS2, C, C++, and Python 

• Solid knowledge in majority of the following fields: 
 

• Sensor fusion for state estimation and localization 

• Control systems for robotics 

• Path planning & Navigation (SLAM) 

• Computer Vision and Machine Learning applied to robotics   

• You’re comfortable working with hardware and in realworld field environments and experience bringing systems from prototype to reliable field deployment 

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your work 

• You have a valid EU driving license (for site testing and deployments) 

• You can communicate fluently in English

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

Are you looking for a varied job where you can both apply your technical knowledge and carry out practical tasks?

Then be sure to apply for this operator position!

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

You take pride in keeping your machine running smoothly and in resolving minor breakdowns or blockages quickly and efficiently.

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C) does not deter you.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.

At 
World of Tents in Ronse, we design, develop and supply shelter solutions and crisis response equipment for organisations operating in some of the world's most demanding environments.
 

Our brands 
ALPINTER and SHIELD, support humanitarian organisations, governments, defence and emergency response teams with reliable products designed to perform when it matters most. To strengthen our Quality team, we are looking for a QHSE Specialist who combines an eye for detail with a hands-on mindset and a passion for continuous improvement in product and performance.
 

WHAT WILL YOU DO? 
As our Quality Management Officer, you contribute to the appropriate quality and reliability of our products, from raw materials to finished solutions. Working closely with our QHSE Manager, WOT Teams, international suppliers and external specialist stakeholders, you combine 
quality management processes, QA/QC coordination with our manufacturing partners and product testing, in a practical & problem-solving manner.
 

Here's where you will make a difference:
 

1. Quality Management & compliance
 
 

• Maintain and improve our Quality Management Systems (QMS), supporting ISO 9001 & 14001 compliance, internal & external audits and QA/QC procedures. 

• Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, product quality and sustainability. 

• Support Product Development and Supply Chain colleagues in Quality related aspects of their work  

2. Product Quality & Testing
 
 

• Define quality requirements and testing procedures for raw materials and finished products,  

• Coordinate product testing for core items such as tents, core relief items and other shelter-related equipment, together with internal teams and external laboratories. 

• Analyse test results, identify risks and translate findings into practical improvements.  

3. Customer & Supplier Quality
 
 

• Ensure our products meet customer specifications and quality expectations. 

• Investigate quality complaints, identify root causes and coordinate corrective actions with the teams involved. 

• Monitor incoming goods and supplier quality, following up on inspection reports and quality issues.  

4. Processes & Sustainability
 
 

• Develop, review and audit standard operating procedures and production controls. 

• Identify opportunities to improve process efficiency, consistency and sustainability in collaboration with the QHSE Manager.  

You work closely with our Quality Officer, who provides practical support during product inspections and testing, and report directly to the QHSE Manager.
 

READY TO MAKE YOUR QUALITIES COUNT?
 

We'd love to hear from you! Send your CV to jobs@wot.group.

We are looking for someone who combines 
technical knowledge with a practical, solution-oriented approach.
 
 

• A degree in Textile Technology, Quality Management, Engineering or a related technical field, or min 3 years of equivalent experience. 

• Experience in respect to quality control processes; experience with ISO 9001/14001 or Quality Management Systems is a plus. 

• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and the ability to turn findings into clear reports and improvements. 

• Comfortable working with MS Office and Data Management systems 

• Fluent in English; Dutch and/or French are an advantage. 

• Experience with textiles, technical fabrics and/or product testing is a plus.  

And just as importantly, you:
 
 

• Are analytical, accurate and looking for solutions

jobs.occupation: iDSB - International German School Brussels - Head of IT Coordination & Administration
jobs.description:
The purpose of this position is to ensure the daily operation, proper maintenance and development of information and communication systems in order to support a high-quality edcuation and an efficient administration of the school. This role becomes more important over time. A high quality IT infrastructure and very good user experience are distinction criteria for the school and therefore a leverage to reach our strategic long term objectives.

The position holder on the one hand needs to be capable of supporting the school staff with a clientoriented mindset on all IT related issues. On the other hand she/he needs to proactively advise on improvements of the IT Infrastructure, support the decision making process and implement such new solutions.
Your tasks (list is not exhaustive)

• Responsible for the daily operation of the School's Information- and Communication Infrastructure

• Maintenance of all Hard- and Software components used in the school (Server, Antivirus, Backups, wired and wireless networks, Firewalls, video conference equipment, endpoints, telephony).

• Ensure the security of all IT systems (apply security patches, manage configurations, ensure Anti-virus and other security updates)

• Ensure all required IT services are available during school hours (7:30 - 17:30) and on request also outside school hours through pro-active maintenance and SWIFT and effective troubleshooting

• Manage the school provided Mobile devices (laptops, tablets, smartphones, mobile phones)

• Management of Contracts: Software Licenses, Maintenance agreements, IT related leasing

• Installation of new systems (including testing, appropriate communication, training etc.)

• Assure connection to external specialists and leverage them as appropriate for the school

• User access Management (including setting up accounts for new users etc.)

• Creation and maintenance of complete documentation of all ICT systems (e.g. network structure, security architecture, overview of servers in operation, network components, end devices such as PCs, tablets, projectors, smartboards, monitors, ...)

• Proactively advise on system changes or new products, which could improve the IT landscape of the school, both in the area of software as well as Hardware

• Monitor and actively advise on developments in the educational environment (Germany, Belgium) as far as Technology in schools is concerned

• Act as an advisor on general IT topics for the school's headmaster and the administrative board

Organization / exposure

• The jobholder reports to the Head of Administration of the School.

• The position is complemented by a junior IT expert, who would report to the jobholder.

• Day-to-day contact with Teachers, administrative staff and students. Occasional contact with external stakeholders (Parents, Administration Board).

• Motivated IT allrounder with 3-5 years relevant experience

• Expertise in providing 1st Level support for a small to medium organization

• Expertise in Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Windows 10 and network technology

• Experience with selection and implementation of new hard- or software.

• Able to communicate with partners with limited IT background when proposing new solutions or changes to existing solutions

• Ideally some project management experience

• Proactivity - you find issues before they find you, eager to push things forward

• Problem Solving Skills

• Hands-on activities are your thing

• Client oriented mindset; self-organized but also a teamplayer

• Ability to prioritise; Adherence to deadlines

• Languages: solid knowledge of English; basic German; French and / or Dutch desirable but not mandatory

jobs.occupation: Nexin - Medior / Senior BizTalk and .NET Developer
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established Belgian logistics and distribution company operating nationwide with multiple sites across the country.

The organization manages time-sensitive distribution flows and supplies thousands of retail points daily. As part of its strategic evolution, the company is expanding into new product categories while modernizing its IT landscape.
The environment combines

• A stable SME culture with flat hierarchy

• Long-term employee retention

• High operational criticality

• A strong ongoing digital transformation program

To strengthen the internal IT team, our client is looking for a Medior / Senior BizTalk & .NET Developer (minimum 5 years of experience).
Your role

You will join an experienced internal IT department (infrastructure + development) and actively contribute to the evolution of business-critical applications.

You will:

•  Design, develop and maintain integrations using Microsoft BizTalk Server 2020 and C#/.NET.

• Create and maintain schemas, MAPS, orchestrations, pipelines, ports and adapter configurations.

• Develop .NET components, services and REST/SOAP integrations; work with XML, XSD, XSLT and JSON.

• Write and optimize SQL Server queries and stored procedures, and implement validation, error handling and logging.

• Translate business requirements into technical solutions with business analysts and application owners.

 

Day to day support

• Monitor interfaces and application health; investigate failed exchanges, suspended messages and processing delays.

• Handle daily support requests and production incidents, prioritize business impact and keep users informed.

• Diagnose issues across BizTalk, .NET, SQL Server and connected systems; coordinate resolution with IT teams and external partners.

• Restore processing safely, including controlled message resubmission, and investigate root causes to prevent recurring incidents.

• Maintain support procedures, runbooks and incident records; turn recurring problems into permanent improvements.

 

Quality and delivery

• Test integrations and .NET changes, including failure scenarios, and contribute to code reviews.

• Manage source code in GIT and support deployments with environment-specific configurations and rollback procedures.

• Document interfaces and technical changes, and share knowledge with colleagues.

You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders and operational teams. As a BizTalk and .NET developer, you will work in tandem with another colleague
Work environment

• Multicultural team

• Flat organizational structure

• Short decision-making lines

• Strong collaboration culture

• Fun culture

• On-site presence in Belgium required (with homeworking)

• At least 5 years of professional experience in software development, including proven experience developing and supporting Microsoft BizTalk and C#/.NET solutions, ideally with BizTalk Server 2020.

• Strong C# and .NET Framework skills, with hands-on experience in Visual Studio.

• Practical knowledge of BizTalk messaging, routing, promoted properties, MAPS, orchestrations and pipelines.

• Experience with XML/XSD, XSLT, JSON, REST/SOAP services and adapters such as sFTP and WCF-SQL.

• Solid SQL Server skills and experience troubleshooting integration or application issues in production.

• Experience with GIT, testing and structured deployment practices.

• Ability and willingness to combine development work with daily application support.

• Proven use of AI tools in software development, such as coding assistants for implementation, testing, debugging and documentation, with critical review of generated output and respect for data confidentiality.

• Fluent in Dutch or French, with a good working command of English.

 

Additional assets

• Experience with SAP integrations, EDI/AS2 or other enterprise systems.

• Knowledge of modern .NET, ASP.NET Core, Azure Logic Apps, Service Bus or API Management.

• Experience with CI/CD, PowerShell, monitoring tools, or Jira and Confluence.

• Knowledge of Broadcom Automic for scheduling and monitoring automated jobs and workflows.

 

Soft skills

• An analytical mindset and a methodical approach to troubleshooting.

• Ownership of issues through to resolution, with clear communication and a focus on business needs.

• Ability to manage priorities calmly, collaborate with colleagues and document solutions clearly.
